children: Lennar settled a $600 million senior notes offering: $300M 5.700% notes due 2029 and $300M 5.950% notes due 2032.
Issued $300M of 5.700% Senior Notes due 2029 and $300M of 5.950% Senior Notes due 2032 to raise $600M.
Notes are guaranteed by certain wholly owned subsidiaries, per the underwriting agreement.
Proceeds are intended for general corporate purposes, providing liquidity for operations or corporate needs.
Notes issued under supplemental indentures dated Oct 15, 2026; offering registered on Form S-3 (File No. 333-294985).
